lines_of_business: Not stated beyond disclaimer to check member contract; Medicare statement: no national coverage position
criteria_location: Coverage (p.1) with NOTE 1 and NOTE 2 (p.2), repeated verbatim in Policy Guidelines (pp.2-3). Rationale is evidence only.
procedures_covered: Therapeutic SI joint corticosteroid injection (CPT 27096, 64451, HCPCS G0260)

logic.top_level: pathways (diagnostic block vs corticosteroid injection), each an ALL list
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Scope exclusion only: 'This policy does not address the treatment of sacroiliac joint (SIJ) pain due to infection, trauma, or neoplasm.' No contraindication list.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Corticosteroid: 'No more than 3 injections are given in 1 year.' No efficacy-of-prior-injection rule.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: which may consist of therapies such as nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory medications, acetaminophen, manipulation, physical therapy, and a home exercise program (See NOTE 1)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'may consist of ... such as' reads optional, but NOTE 1 says conservative therapy 'should include' four mandatory elements with 'and'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: A successful trial of controlled diagnostic lateral branch blocks consists of 2 separate positive blocks
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: NOTE 2 defines the SI diagnostic block by reference to 'lateral branch blocks', a different procedure.

requirement_kinds.quote: Pain has failed to respond to 3 months of conservative (nonsurgical) management
Participation in at least 6 weeks of physical therapy (including active exercise) or documentation of why the patient could not tolerate physical therapy
Use of prescription-strength analgesics for several weeks at a dose sufficient to induce a therapeutic response
Evaluation and appropriate management of associated cognitive, behavioral, or addiction issues
Documentation of compliance with the preceding criteria
Dual (controlled) diagnostic blocks with 2 anesthetic agents with differing duration of action
The injections are performed under imaging guidance
No more than 3 injections are given in 1 year
reduction in pain for the duration of the local anesthetic used (e.g., 3 hours longer with bupivacaine than lidocaine)

thresholds.quote: failed to respond to 3 months of conservative (nonsurgical) management
at least 6 weeks of physical therapy
No more than 3 injections are given in 1 year
for a period of at least 4 weeks before the diagnostic block
There is no consensus on whether a minimum of 50% or 75% reduction in pain would be required

time_windows.quote: at least 6 weeks of physical therapy

time_windows.what: no therapeutic intra-articular injection before diagnostic block
time_windows.quote: at least 4 weeks before the diagnostic block

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Listed only: CPT 27096, 64451; HCPCS G0260. 64451 is the nerve (lateral branch) block, not the joint injection.

external_dependencies.what: Related policies SUR705.033 SI joint fusion, MED201.013 prolotherapy
external_dependencies.quote: SUR705.033 Sacroiliac Joint Fusion or Stabilization
does not have a national Medicare coverage position. Coverage may be subject to local carrier discretion.

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: 2 separate positive blocks on different days with local anesthetic only (no steroids or other drugs)

vague_terms.quote: appropriate management of associated cognitive, behavioral, or addiction issues
a dose sufficient to induce a therapeutic response
There is no consensus on whether a minimum of 50% or 75%
vague_terms.problem: policy declines to set a threshold, so the diagnostic-block success test is not decidable

extraction_hazards: NOTE 1 and NOTE 2 repeated verbatim in Policy Guidelines (duplicate criteria text)
Page footers 'Sacroiliac Joint Injections/SUR705.043 Page N' break lists mid-bullet (Coverage list splits between pp.1-2)
Four-fifths of the 16 pages is rationale/evidence with study percentages
Policy History repeats the old criteria text
interesting_structures: Diagnostic criterion requires TWO blocks with TWO agents of different duration (dual controlled blocks)
Notes moved from Coverage into Policy Guidelines in 2026 revision

fit_to_tree.why: Short ALL lists, but definitions live in notes and several leaves (dual blocks, behavioral evaluation, therapeutic response) are hard to judge from a chart.
